visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of an artificial wave pool filled with light blue water. A group of seagulls is floating on the surface near the bottom edge of the frame. In the background, heavy construction with numerous cranes and high-rise residential buildings is visible under an overcast sky. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a corrugated metal roof on top of a building. Several seagulls are perched along the ridge of the roof, looking in various directions. A sign on the building wall below reads 'Powered by WAVE'. (3) A cut reveals a high-angle shot of a realistic hawk-shaped kite attached to a long, flexible pole. The kite is swaying and 'flying' in the wind against a pale, cloudy sky. The camera pans down to show the pole's base near some small trees and a fence. (4) The final sequence shows the hawk kite from a different angle, soaring above the wave pool area. The camera pans to show the rooftop from the earlier phase, which is now completely devoid of seagulls. In the far distance of the wave pool, two small figures are seen on boards in the water.
